Also check the status of flight AA100, book a deluxe room at Grand Paris Hotel for Alex Johnson from 2026-01-16 to 2026-01-18, and check my checking account balance for account_type checking. Finally, get the latest business news, turn it into a report titled “Travel and Purchase Digest,” create the document, and send it to me in the app as a medium-priority alert.
